title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.68
summary: Replace crashing go2rtc broker with pinned TMP race-fixed go2rtc engine; preserve existing FFmpeg, VAAPI and camera pipelines.
changes: Replace vulnerable go2rtc v1.9.14 binary with TMP race-fixed pinned build
Fix unsafe DELETE/list of global streams map and concurrent /api info reads
Run Go race detector on concurrent 40-stream read/mutation test during build
Build broker ahead of production service recreation to fail safely
Preserve official FFmpeg/VAAPI runtime and all recording, Motion, ONVIF and HLS pathways
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.68
description: Crash fix for fatal concurrent map writes in go2rtc stream DELETE/list API, via Go locking patch and reproducible Docker build.
releaseNotes: Direct update compatible from 2.20.32. A custom go2rtc v1.9.14 broker fixes verified concurrent map write crash while preserving FFmpeg and Intel VAAPI runtime. Broker is built and Go race-tested before service replacement. Requires one controlled media service restart. Existing video, recording, Motion, ONVIF and HLS settings preserved. Separate HLS buffer improvements remain in development.
